overview.text: Today's developments showcase major advances in decision models, driving simulations, and efficient autoregressive generation. In evaluation and architecture, SO-Arena benchmarks System One models for fast general-purpose decision-making, while research explores adaptive computation to optimize decision depth and group-scaled token capacity to resolve spatial compression trade-offs in image generation. In the driving domain, BirdDreams introduces joint perspective and BEV video generation for reactive driving world models, and Duo presents a reciprocal world model for full-duplex audiovisual interaction. Local deployment gains traction with Edge0-145B bringing frontier capabilities to local hardware, complemented by new open releases like ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview and moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro. Finally, industry applications and analysis highlight how companies leverage coding agents and System One architectures to accelerate product shipping and software development workflows.

entries.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
entries.summary: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks.
entries.why: Provides essential capability spectrum and reliability benchmarks for fast System One decision models.

entries.title: Edge0-145B: Frontier AI Capabilities on Your Own Computer
entries.why: Brings frontier AI capabilities directly to local computer hardware for developers.

entries.title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
entries.summary: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control.
entries.why: Advances reactive driving world models with joint perspective and BEV video generation.

entries.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
entries.summary: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time.
entries.why: Enables full-duplex interaction through a reciprocal world model handling continuous audiovisual inputs.

entries.title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
entries.summary: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity.
entries.why: Resolves the trade-off between token sequence length and representation capacity in image generation.

entries.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
entries.summary: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require.
entries.why: Investigates adaptive computation depth to make System One decision models more efficient.

entries.title: Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
entries.summary: Adversarial training is often plagued by "pseudo-attacks", perturbations that significantly increase the loss value but fail to truly alter the model's confidence structure.
entries.why: Addresses pseudo-attacks in adversarial training using structured confidence perturbation via Fisher geometry.

entries.title: ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview
entries.why: Offers a new open-weight model release for local deployment and experimentation.

entries.title: DavidAU/Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-735-882-Heretic-Uncensored-NEO-CODER-MAX-MTP-GGUF
entries.why: Provides a heavily downloaded image-text-to-text model on the Hugging Face hub.

entries.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro
entries.why: Delivers a new transformer-based image-text-to-text model release for developers.

entries.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
entries.summary: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.
entries.why: Demonstrates rapid product shipping using proactive AI agents and OpenAI models.

entries.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
entries.summary: Gondola helps creatives get credit and get hired, with Codex raising its lead engineer’s output by 50% and ChatGPT simplifying daily work.
entries.why: Shows how Codex significantly raises engineering output and team revenue.

entries.title: AI Ambition: ArtCraft Cloned Photoshop and Now Wants to "Rebuild Everything"
entries.summary: ArtCraft used AI to rewrite Photoshop as open source software. For CEO Brandon Thomas, the vision is even bigger: to take back the internet!
entries.why: Explores ambitious open-source software rewriting efforts using AI tools.

entries.title: The Jev Revolution: What Engineers Are Already Building with System One Models
entries.summary: At AI Engineer Code Summit, lead Jev creator Diogo Almeida called on developers to automate everything. Also, Glean and others showed how they’re using Jev.
entries.why: Highlights practical engineering use cases for automated workflows with System One models.

entries.title: The Epoch Brief - November 11, 2026
entries.summary: An open-weight model hacks Firefox for $1,000, AI chips mapped by country, and how biologists are using LLMs
entries.why: Surveys open-weight model exploits, geopolitical chip mapping, and biological LLM applications.
